content.title: Bulky Item Drop Off Events
content.summary: Arvada residents can participate in citywide bulky item drop-off events on April 25, June 6, and August 15, 2026, from 9 am to 2 pm at the North Area Athletic Complex. Proof of residency is required, and participants are limited to five items, with specific guidelines for acceptable materials, including bagged yard waste and metal recycling. Entry is only permitted from westbound W. 64th Parkway, and residents should plan for potential wait times and be prepared to unload their items themselves.
content.body:
![three people unloading bulky items from a truck](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=4090 "three people unloading bulky items from a truck")

## 2026 drop off events

Citywide drop-off events are included in the minimum services that Arvada customers invest in as part of the [City's Recycling and Trash Program.](/715) All Arvada residents are invited to participate.

- **Dates:**
  - Saturday, April 25
  - Saturday, June 6
  - Saturday, August 15
- **Time:**9 am to 2 pm
  - Gates close promptly at 2 pm, late entry is not allowed.
- **Location:**North Area Athletic Complex (NAAC), 19500 W 64th Parkway
  - **Westbound / left turn entry only**from W. 64th Pkwy.
  - This is the only location for bulky item drop-off. **Please do not drop-off items at dumpsters at other parks, fields, or City facilities.**

### Know before you go

- **New: westbound / left turn entry only.**Entry will not be permitted to eastbound traffic on W. 64th Pkwy. All traffic must enter from westbound W. 64th Pkwy.
- **Bring proof of residency.**This event is open to City of Arvada residents. You must provide proof of residency either with a current utility bill or a drivers license with your current address.
- **Plan for extended wait times.**The City team has mapped traffic flow into and out of the event area to help traffic move as smoothly as possible. The goal is to move residents through as efficiently as possible, but wait times could be long. Gate close promptly at 2 pm, late entry is not allowed.
- **Plan to unload your own items.**We will have multiple containers accepting drop offs simultaneously and event staff to direct customers. Please try to unload your items in a timely manner to prevent increased wait times for others.
- **Five item limit/yard waste bagged.**We have a limit on the number of items an individual can bring, and we require smaller materials such as construction debris or yard waste to be bagged.
- **Weather delays.**In the case of inclement weather, drop-off events may be delayed or, in rare cases, canceled. Please check the City's social media (Facebook, Instagram, or X), this webpage (arvadaco.gov/bulkyitems), or [the Waste Hauling Delay alerts](/AlertCenter.aspx?CID=Waste-Hauling-Delay-6).

### Event map

\*Click map to enlarge.

### [Map of traffic flow for the bulky item drop off with entrance from westbound 64th Ave](/DocumentCenter/View/5672/Bulky-Item-Drop-off-Map-2025)

### Acceptable items

- BBQ Grills
- Bagged yard debris
- Baby cribs (wooden)
- Carpet (bundled)
- Chairs
- Coffee tables
- Desks
- Dishwashers
- Doors
- Dressers (small/large)
- End tables
- Garage doors (4-foot sections per section equals one item)
- Hot water heaters

- Lawnmowers (no oil/gas - fluids must be drained)
- Love seats
- Mattresses/Box springs
- Ping Pong Tables (folded)
- Porcelain sinks
- Porcelain toilets
- Recliners
- Sleeper sofas
- Sofas
- Tables
- Tree branches/tree limbs
- Washer/Dryer
- Waterbeds (each section)

**New! Metal recycling.**The following items can be recycled at the event. Space is limited, once capacity is met, metal items will be sent to the other landfill bins.

- Aluminum, aluminum siding and gutters
- Iron
- Chain-link fence (rolled up or with slates removed)
- Lead, cooper, zinc, brass, alloys
- Cast iron
- Steel, stainless steel
- Metal lids
- Chairs (no plastic)

- Tables (metal, no glass inserts)
- Ladders
- Pipes
- Plumbing fixures (metal)
- Electrical cords
- Window frames (no glass)
- Sheet metal
- Appliance (no freon or microwaves)
- BBQ grills (no propane)

## Disposing of tree branches

Tree branches will be accepted at the event providing they meet **these requirements**:

- Branches and limbs must be bundled.
- Bundles must be no larger than 18 inches by 4 feet.
- No more than five bundles will be accepted.

Residents who participate in the City's waste-hauling service can bundle their tree branches/limbs and have them picked up during regular trash delivery for an additional charge. Bundles must be no larger than 18 inches x 4 feet. Contact the Waste and Recycling Program at 720-898-7575 for more information.

## Leaf recycling events

Find information including dates, drop off locations and procedures on the [Leaf Recycling page](/718/Free-Leaf-Recycling).

## Bulky item pick-up service

Residents who participate in the City's waste-hauling cart service can have oversized items that do not fit in carts picked up during regular trash pick up for an additional charge.

[View a list of acceptable and unacceptable items](/1368). **Call 720-898-7575 for more information, current rates, and to coordinate service.**

## Hard to recycle items

The City maintains partnerships with [Rooney Road](https://www.rooneyroadrecycling.org/) and [Sustainability](https://www.sustainability-recycling.com/) recycling centers to help Arvada residents properly dispose of hazardous waste and hard to recycle items. Please visit their websites for the list of accepted items.
